title: A line that states the list's order must match the order the API was asked for
rule: When the UI states how a list is sorted, derive that text from the request it sends, and send an explicit order wherever the API's default differs from the text. fm-core's default for a search is a ranking: fewest missing characters under a coverage filter, best match for text, and only then the name. The TypeScript MockApi does not reproduce those near misses, so a component test over it passes while the line is false. Test the request the store sends for each filter kind, on both sides of the condition.
rationale: E41.4 (#450): the count line said 'Sorted by name' under a language filter while fm-core listed families by fewest missing characters first.
